tagline: You inherited a cold house in a quiet valley. Put the kettle on — you have one year, and one winter, to prove this place can keep its own lights on.
premise: You inherited the old Kettle farm from a great-aunt you barely remember — Josie Kettle, who kept the lights on in this valley long after everyone else stopped trying. The house is a chimney, three walls, a bed frame and a copper kettle over a cold hearth. Outside there is an inn with no innkeeper, a mill with a snapped axle, a store with the shutters down, a marsh full of frog-folk who have not had a neighbour in years, and forty dark lamp posts. Every February for a decade somebody has packed up and left, and nobody has ever come back in April. You have one spring to make this place livable, one summer to make it worth staying, one autumn to fill the larder, and one winter to prove the valley can keep its own lights on. Then it starts again, warmer.

cast.name: Josie Kettle
cast.role: the voice in the book — your dead great-aunt, speaks only through the Patchouli journal
cast.arc: A capable, funny old woman leaving instructions; the handwriting gets shakier and the plans get more ambitious, not less; then the cellar-wall reveal — she built the power plant, ran it for eleven days, and sealed it because a machine one person can run is a hostage, not infrastructure. She was waiting for two of you.

cast.name: Marnie Ashcombe
cast.arc: Spring: comes up the hill because she saw your chimney smoke, bringing bread she baked for nobody. Autumn: admits she has been cooking for one and throwing half of it away; the Harvest Supper is her first real headcount. Winter: her stores run out and she lets you feed her, which is the hardest thing she does all year — afterwards she stops calling the inn 'Josie's place'.

cast.name: Bram Tolliver
cast.arc: Spring: won't accept help, will accept 'hold this' — teaches Create by narrating while you build. Autumn: hands over Josie's schematics he could never make work and stops pretending he's the smartest engineer in the valley. Winter: refuses to leave the mill in the cold snap, has to be fetched with cocoa, and is the one who pulls the lever.

cast.name: Oda Vance
cast.arc: Spring: sells you almost nothing because she has almost nothing, and posts the first bounty out of embarrassment. Autumn: the rail line reaches town, her shelves fill, and she starts special-ordering by name. Second spring: the books balance for the first time in eleven years and she hands you the ledger, which for Oda is a hug.

cast.name: Nella Brightwater
cast.arc: Summer: teaches fishing and the lake's moods, and gives you the dredge net before you ever need it. Summer: the Lantern Float is her idea and she is visibly terrified nobody will come. Winter to spring: the lake freezes and she loses her livelihood; the greenhouse gives her work and she discovers she likes growing things more than she has ever admitted to liking anything.

cast.name: Halden Root
cast.role: herbalist and brewer, keeper of Josie's secret
cast.arc: Spring: trades tea for stories and gives you the herbal starts. Autumn: reads Josie's shorthand off the Kettle Plate and opens the cellar door — he has been dreading it for four years and does it anyway. Winter: keeps the whole valley from getting sick, and admits he stayed because Josie asked him to, and that he's glad.

cast.name: Tobin Gale
cast.arc: Summer: nobody believes his survey; he is right about everything and terrible at explaining it. Autumn: his core samples locate the deep copper, iron, gold and silver, and Bram says 'good work' out loud. Second spring: he calls in the quarry rig, is very calm about it, and fools nobody.

cast.name: Wisp
cast.role: Ribbit forager from the reed village downstream
cast.arc: Spring: first contact, with a basket of things you cannot identify, all of which are delicious. Summer: moves into a stilt house the town builds. Winter: brings the entire reed village in to shelter at the inn, and the two settlements never separate again.

cast.name: Pip Ashcombe
cast.role: Marnie's nephew, nine, courier and bell-ringer
cast.arc: Spring: gets the duckling and names it after you, or after a food. Autumn: appoints himself the town's courier. Winter to spring: notices the Hearth has gone out, and rings the bell at the end. Gets a plushie of his duck.

acts.title: SPRING — The Thaw
acts.beat: You arrive at a cold house in a valley that used to be a town. One neighbour sees your chimney smoke, comes up the hill, and decides you're staying. By the end of spring there are five people in the valley instead of one, the mill turns, and there is a door in your cellar you cannot open.
acts.goal: Make the old Kettle farm livable and wake the town up in time for the Thaw Fair.

quests.title: The Letter and the Kettle
quests.task: Take Josie's Letter out of your bag and read it. The last page is a map.
quests.reward: Josie's Journal (Patchouli), the Copper Kettle, the Kettle Farm Compass, the Homestead Waystone, an iron shovel and pick, 16 cooked food, 16 torches, a Megatorch, Journal Entry 1

quests.title: Somebody Left the Kettle On
quests.task: Follow the compass to the old Kettle farm — the chimney's still standing. Put the waystone on the hearthstone. A box will pop up: type Home and click the tick.
quests.task_type: checkmark·kjs (waystone placed on the ruin hearthstone)
quests.reward: The cottage is re-roofed and re-walled around you with a doorway, two window holes and a wool mat where the bed goes; a door, 4 windows, a bed and a wall lantern

quests.title: Four Walls and a Door
quests.task: Put the door in the doorway, a window in each hole, the bed on the wool mat, and the lantern on the hook by the door. All four are in your bag.
quests.reward: Handcrafted table + 2 chairs, wool rug, 2 flower boxes, a Cooking Pot, a campfire, 16 bricks and a bag of soup vegetables

quests.title: Nothing Gets In
quests.task: Place the Megatorch inside your cottage.
quests.reward: Nothing hostile spawns near home from now on; 2 spare Megatorches for the pens, 2 Feral Flare Lanterns for lighting

quests.title: The Door Under the House
quests.task: There's a trapdoor under the ash in the old kitchen — it's glowing. Dig the gravel out of the stairs, about 75 marked blocks. The shovel's in your bag.
quests.reward: A sealed iron door with no handle and Josie's chalk: 'Not yet. — J.K.' Cellar Waystone, Josie's tool chest

quests.title: Put the Kettle On
quests.task: Put the campfire down outside your door, hang the Copper Kettle on the hook above it, and cook one Vegetable Soup in the Cooking Pot. Everything's in the basket.
quests.reward: Skillet, Farmer's Delight knife, 3 sacks of assorted seeds

quests.title: Where the Square Goes
quests.task: Bram's old Surveyor's Stake. Walk toward the road north of your gate until the ground under you goes green, then right-click. This is where the town will be.
quests.task_type: checkmark·kjs (Town Anchor listener — build this first)
quests.reward: Anchor recorded; a stone path is laid from your door to the anchor and the first two lamp posts go up (2/40)

quests.title: Chimney Smoke
quests.task: Sleep one night.
quests.reward: Marnie arrives; the inn shell is built at the anchor; 8 loaves, the Inn Waystone, 32 Green Oak Planks and a flint and steel

quests.title: Three Beds of Dirt
quests.task: Till the 3x9 patch behind the house — it's marked in path blocks — and plant the wheat, carrots and potatoes from Marnie's sack.
quests.reward: Watering can, 16 bone meal, straw hat, scarecrow, 4 fence sections, a gate and a trough, three Hen Crates

quests.title: Two Hens and a Rooster
quests.task: Put a fence section on each marked block behind the house, hang the gate, then right-click the three Hen Crates inside the pen.
quests.reward: Nesting box placed with 2 eggs already in it, chicken feed (right-click a hen and she lays), a Megatorch over the coop, 3 eggs

quests.title: Pip and the Egg
quests.task: Collect 3 eggs from the nesting box and take them to Marnie.
quests.reward: Pip arrives; a Duckling to name and keep; Pip's courier board unlocks; 16 wool from Marnie's carding basket

quests.title: The Man at the Broken Mill
quests.task: Walk to the mill plot marked on your map and talk to Bram.
quests.reward: Bram arrives; Create wrench, goggles, 12 iron ingots and 24 andesite

quests.title: Eight Alloys, No More
quests.task: Make 8 Andesite Alloy from exactly what Bram gave you.
quests.reward: Mechanical Press (pre-made), 8 cogwheels, 8 shafts, 32 wheat — Bram's winter store, he's sick of porridge

quests.title: Turn It By Hand
quests.task: Build a Millstone, attach a Hand Crank, and grind 16 wheat into flour for Marnie.
quests.reward: Encased Fan, 3 Andesite Alloy, saw-blade parts

quests.title: The Green Boards
quests.task: Put the 32 Green Oak Planks in the inn's oven, light it with the flint and steel, then go to bed. They'll be dry when you wake up.
quests.reward: The boards go straight into Bram's crate. You get the inn's spare tea set, the pantry key, a chair by the oven, and a pre-made Kitchen Counter, Sink and Oven. Stage 'seasoned'

quests.title: Water Finds a Way
quests.task: Build 2 Water Wheels on the mill race and drive the Millstone off them.
quests.reward: Mechanical Saw (pre-made), Basin, Mechanical Mixer, Bram's crate: 32 Andesite Alloy and 16 wool for the sails

quests.title: Sawdust and Shingles
quests.task: Cut 128 boards on the Saw and hand Bram 64 of them for the market stalls.
quests.reward: Macaw's roof kit x3, 4 planters, stage 'market_stalls'

quests.title: Marnie's Kitchen
quests.task: Put the Counter, Sink and Oven on the three marked spots along the inn's back wall, then cook Bread, Pumpkin Pie and Vegetable Soup. Everything's in the crate by the counter.
quests.task_type: item (3 CfB blocks held) + item (3 named dishes)
quests.reward: Cookbook, fruit basket, 5 recipes learned automatically, Handcrafted cupboard set

quests.title: The Store Reopens
quests.task: Sweep the cobwebs out of the store with Oda's broom — they're marked — then bring her 16 flour and 8 loaves of bread.
quests.task_type: item (flour x16 + bread x8, consume) + checkmark
quests.reward: Act I finale — The Thaw Fair

finale.description: The Thaw Fair. Spring is force-set, the market square is pad-and-templated at the Town Anchor with four stalls, a plaza, bunting and a long table, the mill race is cut so Q16's water wheels have water on any terrain, lamps go to 6, Marnie/Bram/Oda/Pip are summoned in festival dialog with Pip's duckling at his feet, every player gets a Fair Basket and 25 Scrip, the Town Square Waystone is set, the border opens to 3,000 announced by Tobin, and Journal Entry 2 unlocks.

acts.title: SUMMER — The Long Days
acts.beat: The town is awake and immediately too small. Summer is abundance you can't store, water you can't move, and light you don't have. Nella comes back to the lake, Halden opens the hedge garden, and the mill stops being a mill and starts being a workshop.
acts.goal: Make summer's abundance usable — power the workshop, work the lake, and throw the town a party on the water.

quests.title: Frogs in the Reeds
quests.task: Marnie's Explorer's Compass is already set to the Ribbit village — four minutes past the reeds, and Wisp walked over and set a waystone there so you don't have to walk back. Follow it and trade with the frog folk.
quests.reward: Wisp befriended, basket of marsh produce, Sophisticated Backpack, Ribbit Village Waystone, three flower seed packets and bone meal

quests.title: The Beached Boat
quests.task: Follow the marker to the lake and talk to the woman fixing a boat that doesn't need fixing.
quests.reward: Nella arrives; Aquaculture Iron Rod, tackle box, Lake Waystone; a pasture outline is drawn in path blocks behind the barn with a fence kit, a Cow Crate and a Sheep Crate

quests.title: Something With Fins
quests.task: Catch 10 fish of any kind and cook one in the Skillet.
quests.reward: 16 bait, Fish Bag, 2 recipes, Nella's hat, Nella's Dredge Net and a diving cap

quests.title: The Hedge and the Still
quests.task: Halden wants poppies, dandelions and cornflowers. Plant the three seed packets in your window boxes, bone-meal them, and bring him 8 of each.
quests.reward: Halden arrives; herb garden and the spring above it placed; HerbalBrews starter kit, tea set, a trellis kit, 4 grape starts and a filled watering can

quests.title: Vines on the South Slope
quests.task: Place the trellis on the marked terrace behind Halden's hedge, plant the 4 starts, water them twice.
quests.reward: 12 more grape starts, wine press, Handcrafted wine rack, stage 'vinery'

quests.title: Bees, Cows, and a Sheep Named Later
quests.task: Put a fence section on every marked block behind the barn, hang the gate, then right-click the Cow Crate and the Sheep Crate inside.
quests.task_type: checkmark·kjs (2 cows + 2 sheep in the pasture box)
quests.reward: Milk churn, shears, 16 wool, Pasture Waystone, sheep plushie, Megatorch

quests.title: Dredging the Shallows
quests.task: Sit in Nella's boat and pull the dredge net six times. You never get in the water.
quests.reward: 96 more Lake Sand (192 total), Nella's oar, stage 'dredged'

quests.title: The Rock Kid
quests.task: Talk to the young man camped by the copper outcrop with too many notebooks.
quests.reward: Tobin arrives; Geolosys prospector's pick, 3 survey maps already marked

quests.title: Read the Rock
quests.task: Use Tobin's pick on the 6 spots he marked and find the copper cluster.
quests.reward: Copper and the tin deposit marked as map waypoints, 32 copper ingots, 32 raw iron (Tobin's sample bags), Vein Mining I enchanted book

quests.title: A Wheel That Doesn't Freeze
quests.task: Build a Windmill Bearing with 8 sails on the mill roof so the workshop runs when the stream is low. The wool is in Bram's crate.
quests.reward: 6 gearboxes, clutch, gearshift, 3 Mechanical Crafters

quests.title: Wash the Sand
quests.task: Wash Lake Sand under an Encased Fan over water to make 64 Washed Silica.
quests.reward: 64 more Washed Silica, stage 'silica', 2 Deployers

quests.title: Josie's First Schematic
quests.task: Take Bram's crate of Josie's papers and craft your first Thermal Machine Frame.
quests.reward: 2 spare Machine Frames, Redstone Furnace, 32 Fluxduct, a Stirling Dynamo

quests.title: The Long Bench
quests.task: Build a proper workshop room at the mill: 6 Storage Drawers, a controller, 3 Sophisticated barrels. Deliberately before the Pulverizer — its storage is what makes the ore trip short.
quests.reward: 6 drawer upgrades, controller remote, Backpack tier 2 for every player

quests.title: The Pulverizer
quests.task: Build a Thermal Pulverizer and run 32 iron ore through it.
quests.reward: Doubled ore forever, Thermal Sawmill, 8 Redstone Servos, a second Stirling Dynamo

quests.title: The Lantern Road, First Stretch
quests.task: Place 4 lamp posts on the marked spots from the mill to the square, and power two of them from the Redstone Furnace with Fluxduct. All posts and duct supplied.
quests.task_type: checkmark·kjs (posts on whitelisted anchor-relative coords, pushed to persistentData.lamps[])
quests.reward: Lamps 10/40; hostile spawns suppressed along the whole road

quests.title: A House on Stilts
quests.task: Wisp's platform is already out over the shallows. Put a post on each of the six marks, then the bed, the door, the windows and the three lanterns where they're marked.
quests.reward: Wisp moves to town; marsh trade opens; Ribbit plushie; 24 paper and 24 torches from Oda's stockroom

quests.title: Two Hundred Lanterns
quests.task: Craft 24 paper lanterns with Marnie and Pip from the paper and torches in the crate.
quests.reward: Lantern crate, festival clothes, 20 Valley Scrip

quests.title: The Bounty Board Fills Up
quests.task: Fill Oda's three notices: 24 wheat, 8 cooked fish, 8 wool. Hand-authored — random bounties appear only in Endless Seasons, after the story ends.
quests.reward: Act II finale — The Midsummer Lantern Float

finale.description: The Midsummer Lantern Float. Summer is force-set at midnight, a pier is templated at the Lake Waystone, the dredging shallows are dug, two runs of candle holders light the pier, lamps go to 12, all six residents are teleported onto the pier for Nella's four-word rehearsed toast, fireworks fire, the tech lane receives an empty Energy Cell as the visible next tier, the border opens to 6,000, the Pier Waystone is set, and Journal Entry 3 unlocks. The empty granary shell is also templated at the anchor so Act III's Q39 is twelve drawers into twelve alcoves, not a build.

acts.title: AUTUMN — The Harvest Debt
acts.beat: The valley finally produces more than it eats — and Oda opens the ledger and shows everyone the truth: at this rate the town runs out of food and fuel in February. Autumn is where cozy work becomes preservation and tech work becomes storage and logistics. And Halden finally reads what is written on the Kettle Plate, and opens the door under your house.
acts.goal: Fill the granary and finish Josie's storage system before winter — and feed the whole town at the Harvest Supper.

quests.title: Oda Opens the Ledger
quests.task: Talk to Oda at the store. She counts the town's stores out loud.
quests.reward: The winter checklist (in-book), 30 Valley Scrip, granary blueprint

quests.title: The Granary
quests.task: The shell went up at the Lantern Float. Put a drawer in each of the twelve marked alcoves.
quests.reward: Drawers arrive pre-filled with the town's current stock, Granary Waystone, stage 'granary', and Oda's brass weighing scales with her initials scratched off and yours scratched on

quests.title: Autumn Sowing
quests.task: Plant the autumn seed pack — pumpkin, beetroot, squash, cranberry — in the marked beds. These are the only things that grow now.
quests.reward: Seasonal almanac, second scarecrow, 3 recipes, and the larder crate: 32 eggs, 32 sugar, 12 milk, 32 raw meat, 16 apples, 12 empty jars

quests.title: Halden's Spring
quests.task: Follow Halden up to the spring above the hedge garden and fill 3 bottles of Spring Water.
quests.reward: Spring Water x3, stage 'springwater', herbal tea set, 16 certus quartz crystals from Josie's jar on Halden's shelf

quests.title: Preserves and Pickles
quests.task: Make 4 Apple Pies, 4 Jars of Pickles and 4 Jars of Jam. The recipes are on pages 3-5 of your cookbook and everything you need is in the crate by the counter.
quests.reward: 4 preserving crocks, pie safe, Marnie's pickling notes, and a drying rack Halden found in Josie's shed. Quest text carries Bram's note about the fridge blueprint

quests.title: The Bakery Line
quests.task: Bake 4 loaves, 2 pies and 2 cakes in the inn kitchen.
quests.reward: Bakery display set, apron, cake plushie, Marnie's autumn beat

quests.title: Pip's First Run
quests.task: Run 3 of Pip's courier parcels.
quests.reward: Courier satchel, a drawing of you that is mostly hat, 15 Scrip

quests.title: Smoked, Salted, Hung
quests.task: Hang 8 raw meat on the drying rack in the shed behind the inn. No Nether needed — the Nether doesn't open until the end of this act.
quests.reward: 32 cured meat, smokehouse decor, stage 'larder'

quests.title: Guest Rooms
quests.task: Fit out the inn's two upstairs bedrooms — a bed, a rug, a lantern and a chest on each marked spot. Everything's in the packet.
quests.reward: Two rooms Marnie can rent, the first arrival's letter, 15 Scrip

quests.title: Wisp's Marsh Harvest
quests.task: Gather 12 marsh crops from the marked plants downstream with Wisp.
quests.reward: Rare marsh seeds, frog-village decor set, 15 Scrip

quests.title: Nella's Autumn Catch
quests.task: Catch 8 fish before the lake turns and salt them into the granary.
quests.reward: Salt barrel, Nella's autumn beat, 15 Scrip

quests.title: What Tobin Found
quests.task: Take Tobin's 3 core samples to the marked hillside and dig out the adit, about 90 marked blocks.
quests.task_type: item (valley:kettle_plate_a, hold — GLM-injected into the adit's Lootr chest)
quests.reward: Deep copper, iron, gold and silver clusters revealed as waypoints; Vein Mining II; 64 pre-made bronze and electrum stock; a Lootr Artifact and the Kettle Plate

quests.title: Induction
quests.task: Build a Thermal Induction Smelter and alloy 8 bronze and 8 electrum.
quests.reward: Centrifugal Separator, 64 Fluxduct, 2 more Machine Frames

quests.title: The Cell on the Wall
quests.task: Charge a Thermal Energy Cell off your dynamos and run Fluxduct to the inn.
quests.task_type: item (energy cell held) + checkmark·kjs (duct within 12 of inn)
quests.reward: The Works Power Tap — Fridge, Sink and Milk Jar now craftable. One spare Energy Cell

quests.title: Rails to the Road
quests.task: Lay a Steam 'n' Rails line from the mill to the square with a Create train station. 64 rails and 32 track are in the packet.
quests.reward: Train kit: engine and 2 cars, pre-made. Station bell, stage 'trainline'

quests.title: Oda's Wagon Comes In
quests.task: Unload Oda's first proper delivery crate from the station.
quests.task_type: item (valley:delivery_crate, consume — spawned in the station chest by Q48's reward)
quests.reward: Oda's catalogue tier 3 — the full Macaw's / Handcrafted / Supplementaries decor list, seeds and animals, purchasable with Scrip

quests.title: Quartz in Water
quests.task: Plant Certus Quartz Seeds in Halden's Spring Water and grow 32 certus. Josie's jar gets the first accelerator running immediately.
quests.reward: AE2 Inscriber, meteorite compass already pointing, Crystal Growth Accelerator parts

quests.title: The First Terminal
quests.task: Build an ME Drive with 2 storage cells and a terminal in the mill workshop.
quests.reward: 4 more cells, import/export bus set, stage 'ae_basic'

quests.title: Everything In One Place
quests.task: Storage-bus the granary's drawers onto the network so the whole town's stock shows on one screen.
quests.reward: Wireless Terminal + charger, a second wireless terminal to hand your partner, Oda's ledger now auto-updates in-book

quests.title: The Order Board
quests.task: Put a Delivery Crate beside Oda's bounty board and point an AE2 export bus at it with the town's standing orders patterned in.
quests.reward: Every delivery and 'bring X to Y' quest from here on is already filled when you walk up. 60 Scrip

quests.title: The Plate in the Door
quests.task: Take the Kettle Plate from the adit to Halden. He has been able to read Josie's shorthand for four years and has been avoiding it.
quests.task_type: item (kettle plate A, consume, via NPC handshake)
quests.reward: The cellar door turns one quarter and stops. Journal Part Two. Bigger Reactors recipes revealed — casings still need Josie's Turbine Notes

quests.title: What Josie Actually Built
quests.task: Go down into the cellar and read the wall.
quests.reward: The reveal. Works Waystone, Josie's steel tool chest, her original reactor blueprint framed as a decor block

quests.title: Setting the Table
quests.task: Put a Place Setting on each of the twelve marked spots on the long table, and the centrepiece in the middle.
quests.reward: Act III finale — The Harvest Supper

finale.description: The Harvest Supper, then the turn. Autumn is force-set at golden hour, the square is dressed with pumpkins, hay bales and hanging lanterns, the granary facade and noticeboard go up, lamps reach 22 and residents 11, all eight residents are teleported to seated marks with one tellraw line each, Wisp brings three more Ribbits, Pip's duckling is served first, and every player receives a Harvest Gift loot roll. Six seconds later the season fires forward to winter, snow starts, Oda says the line the act was built on, and the border opens to 10,000 in the overworld and 1,250 in the Nether.

acts.title: WINTER — The Longest Night
acts.beat: The crisis, played warm and never grim. Nothing kills anybody. The valley gets cold and dark and boring — crops stop, the lake freezes, Nella loses her work, Marnie's stores run down, the Ribbits can't stay in the marsh, and the whole town crowds into one building. The fix is the thing Josie shut down: the Works becomes a reactor, the reactor heats a greenhouse and a bathhouse, and the valley grows food in January for the first time in its history.
acts.goal: Keep everyone warm and fed through winter, and finish Josie's power plant so the valley never has to go dark again.

quests.title: The Hearth Goes Out
quests.task: Sleep one night after the Supper, then follow Pip down to the inn.
quests.reward: Everyone gathers; the Winter chapter opens. 64 Firewood Bundles, a warm cloak, the cocoa recipe

quests.title: Firewood for Eight Houses
quests.task: Give 16 Firewood Bundles each to Marnie, Halden, Nella and Oda.
quests.task_type: item (firewood bundle x16 x4, consume — four tasks, because an NPC cannot accept an item)
quests.reward: Each gives something back — blanket, tonic, smoked trout, lamp oil. Sleigh bells. Wisp's lantern path is lit down the frozen river

quests.title: The Reed Village Comes In
quests.task: The river's ice now — you can walk it. Follow Wisp's lanterns downstream and bring the Ribbits home.
quests.reward: 4 Ribbit residents added to town, frog-village decor set, Nella's ice auger, Wisp's chain closes, 25 Scrip

quests.title: Soup for a Full Room
quests.task: Cook one stew big enough for twelve and serve it at the inn.
quests.reward: Marnie's chain closes; her recipe book; the Hearth relights; the greenhouse shell goes up at the square; 25 Scrip

quests.title: Ice Fishing
quests.task: Use Nella's auger on the lake ice, then catch 4 Northern Pike and 4 Rainbow Trout.
quests.task_type: item (two named real Aquaculture species x4 each)
quests.reward: Winter tackle, 2 trophies, Nella's winter beat

quests.title: Halden's Rounds
quests.task: Brew 8 winter tonics and take one each to Marnie, Bram, Oda, Nella, Tobin, Wisp, Pip and Halden.
quests.reward: Halden's chain closes; his half of Josie's recipe book, medicine cabinet, stage 'healthy', 25 Scrip

quests.title: Pip's Winter Job
quests.task: Run 5 of Pip's courier deliveries. One click each now — the Delivery Crate fills them.
quests.reward: Pip's chain closes; the duckling grows up; Duck Plushie; courier satchel; 25 Scrip

quests.title: The Cold Frame
quests.task: Put a window in each of the six frames of the greenhouse shell, hang the door, and set the 8 planters on the marked bench.
quests.reward: A potting bench, a rack of seed trays, and Nella starts coming down to sit in it in the evenings because it's the only quiet room in town

quests.title: Winter Windows
quests.task: Dress the inn for the solstice — a wreath, a garland and a candle on each of the twelve marked spots.
quests.reward: Solstice decor set, Marnie's mulled cider recipe, 15 Scrip

quests.title: Teaching Pip to Bake
quests.task: Bake 4 loaves with Pip standing on a stool.
quests.reward: Pip's own apron, one genuinely bad loaf you can keep forever, 15 Scrip

quests.title: The Wool Line
quests.task: Shear the flock, spin the wool and make 4 blankets — one for each empty house.
quests.reward: Loom set, the four blankets placed on four beds, 15 Scrip

quests.title: The Bathhouse Fit-Out
quests.task: He built it and left it bare. Benches, towel racks and lanterns on the marked spots.
quests.reward: Bathhouse decor set, hot-spring plushie, 15 Scrip

quests.title: Open the Works
quests.task: Clear the collapsed adit into Josie's works, about 90 marked blocks, and set a waystone inside.
quests.reward: Works interior lit, Josie's steel tools, a Lootr Artifact, stage 'drilling', a saddled horse in the Works stable

quests.title: The Grid
quests.task: Run Fluxduct from the mill to the Works and install 2 more Energy Cells.
quests.reward: 2 pre-made cells, Thermal servo/filter set, stage 'grid'

quests.title: The Second Plate
quests.task: Explorer's Compass, already set to the Wandering Merchant's Tower. A waystone is standing at its gate — click it and walk in. Bring back the last Kettle Plate from the vault chest.
quests.task_type: item (valley:kettle_plate_b, hold — GLM on that structure's loot table)
quests.reward: Josie's Turbine Notes x16: Bigger Reactors casings now craftable. 2 Artifacts

quests.title: Autocrafting
quests.task: Build a Crafting CPU and a Molecular Assembler so the network builds the boring parts for you.
quests.task_type: item (molecular assembler + crafting storage, hold — never task on encoded patterns)
quests.reward: CPU housing and 4 co-processors, 4 ME Interfaces

quests.title: Yellorium
quests.task: Follow the deep survey to Josie's yellorite pocket — a guaranteed cluster at a fixed offset from the Works waystone — and process 64 ore.
quests.reward: 128 yellorium ingots; 64 reactor casings auto-crafted by your own network while you walk back

quests.title: Build the Vessel
quests.task: Assemble the reactor: casing shell, controller, fuel rods, control rods, access port.
quests.reward: Reactor computer port, redstone port, Josie's blueprint framed

quests.title: The Turbine
quests.task: A problem, not a recipe. Bram's crate contains a fixed budget of rotor blades, coils and casing. Build a turbine that holds 1,800 RPM under load without exceeding it.
quests.task_type: checkmark + /valley check turbine (Checkmark fallback behind a config flag)
quests.reward: Stage 'reactor_ready' — the lever is live. A tuning page in the journal with Josie's own numbers pencilled in the margin

quests.title: The Coolant Loop Goes Somewhere
quests.task: Josie's rule: the waste heat goes to the town, not the sky. Run fluid and Fluxduct from the reactor to 6 greenhouse heaters and the bathhouse tank behind the inn.
quests.reward: Heaters live, bathhouse built and steaming, Greenhouse Glass recipe enabled world-wide

quests.title: Bring Bram
quests.task: Go and get Bram from the mill. He will say no. Bring him anyway. Bring cocoa.
quests.reward: Bram's chain closes; his father's wrench; the lever quest unlocks; 25 Scrip

quests.title: The Lantern Road, Second Stretch
quests.task: Place the last 17 posts on the marked spots, mill to square to lake. When the last post goes down the duct runs itself along the line.
quests.reward: Lamps 39/40. One post is left bare on purpose: Josie's porch

quests.title: Tobin's Numbers
quests.task: Let Tobin run the safety check: verify fuel, coolant flow and control-rod insertion in the reactor UI.
quests.reward: Act IV finale — The Longest Night. Tobin's chain closes, 25 Scrip

finale.description: The Longest Night — the centrepiece. Winter at midnight with snow. Every resident, eight plus four Ribbits, is teleported to marks outside the Works with one tellraw line each; Pip rings the hand bell. The player hands Bram the lever and quest completion schedules the instant: the lever is setblock to powered, KubeJS iterates persistentData.lamps[] and lights all 39 posts down every street at once, the greenhouse heaters come on, the bathhouse starts steaming, and a setblock relights the inn's Hearth. Greenhouse Glass is enabled world-wide, the cozy player gets a Winter Seed Pack and a watering can that never empties, the tech lane sees the Works Deed listed at Oda's counter, and Journal Entry 5 unlocks. The border does not move.
commands: # KubeJS iterates persistentData.lamps[] and emits one setblock per stored coord: setblock <x> <y> <z> supplementaries:lantern_post_lit

acts.title: SECOND SPRING — Founder's Day
acts.beat: The valley survived a winter for the first time in a decade, and people start arriving on their own. The victory lap has teeth: the town formally re-founds itself, the deed to the Works is bought and signed over, and the quarry goes in — not as a strip mine, as the town's public works. Every arc closes on screen.
acts.goal: Re-found the town: finish the square, balance the books, and sink the quarry that pays for the next hundred years.

quests.title: Thaw, Again
quests.task: Sleep one night after the Longest Night and walk the square with Marnie.
quests.reward: Spring seed pack, flower crates, stage 'year_two', the noticeboard updates

quests.title: Greenhouse Glass
quests.task: Glaze the cold frame with Greenhouse Glass and grow 4 out-of-season crops in it at once.
quests.reward: Nella's chain closes — she takes the gardener's job. Rare seeds, master gardener's kit, Nella's top-tier rod and 32 of each bait, 25 Scrip, and the Winter Tomato trophy

quests.title: Paint the Town
quests.task: Put one item on each of the 30 marked copper tiles in the square. Any order is right — Oda has opinions but she's wrong. Every block is in this quest's opening packet.
quests.reward: Oda's full catalogue goes free, stage 'square_finished', a framed map of the town for your wall

quests.title: The Fishing Derby
quests.task: Nella wants six for the wall: Bluegill, Perch, Trout, Pike, Catfish and Carp. Trout and Pike are in the cold water off the pier; the rest are anywhere. Worm bait for the bottom feeders. Mount 3 on the inn wall.
quests.reward: Trophy mounts, fisher plushie, 50 Scrip

quests.title: Reactor, Scaled
quests.task: A problem, not a recipe. Hit the town's stated winter power budget with a second turbine, without exceeding the fuel burn Tobin signed off on.
quests.task_type: checkmark + /valley check power (Checkmark fallback behind a config flag)
quests.reward: Stage 'big_power', Thermal augment set, live energy readout in the journal

quests.title: Everything, Everywhere
quests.task: Full network: 2 Crafting CPUs, wireless access across the whole town, and a subnet that keeps Marnie's pantry stocked forever.
quests.task_type: item (2 crafting storage 16k + wireless boosters, hold)
quests.reward: Wireless boosters, a terminal for every player, Oda's stock syncs to the network

quests.title: Eight Favourite Meals
quests.task: Cook and deliver each resident's favourite dish. The book lists all eight — and the network has already crafted every ingredient into the Delivery Crate.
quests.reward: Commemorative dish set, a warm line from each of them, and the Feast Crate: one of each of the eight, kept for Founder's Day

quests.title: Out Past the Ridge
quests.task: Take the boat out with Nella and Pip to the Cairn Chapel and the Drowned Lighthouse. Waystones are standing at both; the chest in each is under a beacon beam.
quests.task_type: item (2 GLM-injected artifacts, one per named structure)
quests.reward: 2 Artifacts, a Lootr luck upgrade, travel journal pages, the Warding Lamp

quests.title: Deeper and Darker
quests.task: Follow Tobin's lanterns down into the echo cave under the Works and bring back an echo sample. No ancient city, no Warden — the sculk down here is dead and Tobin is already talking.
quests.task_type: item (echo shard) + checkmark·kjs on the scripted echo cave
quests.reward: Deep survey data — this is what sites the quarry. Corpse-recovery token

quests.title: The Ledger Balanced
quests.task: Pay off the town's winter debt at Oda's counter: 120 Valley Scrip.
quests.reward: Oda's chain closes. She hands you the ledger. Quartermaster's chest, 25 Scrip

quests.title: The Works Deed
quests.task: Buy the deed at Oda's counter: 80 Valley Scrip, and Standing: Trusted — six of eight resident chains closed.
quests.task_type: item (valley:scrip x80, consume) + checkmark (hidden 'Standing: Trusted' quest)
quests.reward: The Deed — QuarryPlus is now craftable. The residents vote; Bram signs as witness

quests.title: Sink the Shaft
quests.task: Place the QuarryPlus rig and its markers on the site Tobin surveyed, and power it from the reactor.
quests.reward: Quarry running. Pump and filler modules. Tobin's arc closes

quests.title: The First Load
quests.task: Route the quarry's output into the ME network, then deliver 1,024 cobblestone from network stock to the granary. A bounded first cycle — the quarry keeps running after.
quests.reward: Stage 'town_provides' — Oda's store now restocks itself from your network, permanently

quests.title: A Bell for the Square
quests.task: Cast a bell from the quarry's own copper and hang it on the marked post in the finished square.
quests.reward: Bell placed. Every resident comes out. Pip becomes the bell-ringer — his arc closes

quests.title: The Last Lamp
quests.task: Walk up to Josie's porch and put the fortieth lamp on the bare post.
quests.task_type: checkmark·kjs (block placed at the one known porch coord)
quests.reward: Lamps 40/40. Josie's Lantern (never burns out), a memorial bench, Journal Entry 5 epilogue page

quests.title: The Feast
quests.task: Set the eight dishes from the Feast Crate on the long table and light the Hearth.
quests.reward: Act V finale — Founder's Day

finale.description: Founder's Day. Spring at noon, clear. The finished town is pad-and-templated: town hall facade, a signpost carrying every resident's name reading COPPER KETTLE / VALLEY / pop. 15 / est. again, a stone bridge, the rebuilt mill roof, banners, paved square, flower beds. Lamps 40, residents 15. All residents plus three new arrivals spawn 24 blocks out on a pre-filled path with a follow objective so they walk the last stretch in. Halden reads the last page of Josie's journal as five tellraw lines, each scheduling the next. Every player receives the Kettle Family Deed, a Founder's Plaque with their own name on it, the plushie set, a top-tier backpack and a Copper Kettle trophy. Fireworks, a long chord, and proximity voice chat around a full table — which needs no code at all. The border opens to 60,000,000 in both dimensions and the Endless Seasons chapter unlocks, which is the only place random Bountiful bounties ever appear.

tellraw @a {"text":"The valley's fine now. Go see what's past the ridge — and come home for supper.","color":"gold","italic":true}
